mapper.select: SELECT /*LGVATT50020.retrieveHoliday*/ tah.subsidiary_code /* 해외법인코드 */ ,tah.time_and_attendance_yyyy /* 휴일년도 */ ,TO_CHAR(tah.holiday_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') as holiday_date /* 휴일 */ ,TO_CHAR(tah.holiday_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as before_holiday_date /* 키값 휴일 */ ,tah.holiday_code /* 휴일코드 */ ,tah.holiday_name /* 휴일명 */ ,tah.time_and_attendance_code /* Attendance Code */ ,tac.time_and_attendance_name /* Attendance name */ ,tah.public_hours /*public hours HMT_20210323*/ ,tah.shift_type_codes /*Add shift_type_codes column HMT_20251201*/ ,(select local_language_full_name from lgcom_user_m where application_user_id = tah.creation_user_id) as creation_user_id /* 등록자ID */ ,TO_CHAR(tah.creation_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') as creation_date /* 등록일자 */ FROM tb_att_holiday_info_n tah LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_att_code_c tac ON tac.time_and_attendance_code = tah.time_and_attendance_code WHERE tac.use_flag = 'Y' AND tah.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} -- Session Parameter로 셋팅 AND tah.time_and_attendance_yyyy = #{timeAndAttendanceYyyy} ORDER BY tah.holiday_date asc

SELECT /*LGVATT50020.retrieveHolidayNameList*/ lcm.common_code as code, lcm.common_code_name as name FROM lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c lcm ,lgcom_common_code_c lcc WHERE lcm.code_type_code = 'LGVHR_HOLIDAY_CODE' AND lcm.code_type_code = lcc.code_type_code AND lcm.common_code = lcc.common_code AND lcm.language_code = #{languageCode} -- session language AND lcc.use_flag = 'Y'

SELECT /*LGVATT50020.retrieveHolidayAttendance*/ tac.time_and_attendance_code code, tac.time_and_attendance_name as name FROM tb_att_code_c tac WHERE tac.time_and_attendance_short_name like '%Holiday' AND tac.use_flag = 'Y' AND tac.subsidiary_code = #{subsidiaryCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE /*LGVATT50020.updateHoliday*/ tb_att_holiday_info_n SET time_and_attendance_code = #{timeAndAttendanceCode} , holiday_date = trunc(TO_DATE(#{holidayDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) /* 휴일 */ , holiday_code = #{holidayCode} /* 휴일코드 */ , holiday_name = ( SELECT distinct lcm.common_code_name FROM lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c lcm WHERE lcm.code_type_code = 'LGVHR_HOLIDAY_CODE' AND lcm.common_code = #{holidayCode} group by lcm.common_code_name) /* 휴일명 */ , public_hours = #{publicHours} /* public hours HMT_20210323*/ , shift_type_codes = #{shiftTypeCodes} /* Add shift_type_codes column HMT_20251201*/ , last_update_user_id = #{applicationUserId} /* 최종수정사용자아이디 */ , last_update_date = trunc(sysdate) /* 최종수정일자 */ WHERE subsidiary_code = #{subsidiaryCode} /* 해외법인코드 */ AND time_and_attendance_yyyy = #{timeAndAttendanceYyyy} /* 휴무일 년도 */ AND holiday_date = trunc(TO_DATE(#{beforeHolidayDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) /* 휴일 */

update.if: UPDATE tb_att_base_bas_n SET TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_CODE = 'WH' ,WORK_HOURS = 0 , last_update_user_id = #{applicationUserId} /* 최종수정사용자아이디 */ , last_update_date = trunc(sysdate) /* 최종수정일자 */ WHERE time_and_attendance_date = trunc(TO_DATE(#{holidayDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AND SHIFT_TYPE_CODE IN (SELECT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(s.shift_type_codes, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) FROM tb_att_holiday_info_n s WHERE s.holiday_date = trunc(TO_DATE(#{holidayDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(s.shift_type_codes, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL)

UPDATE tb_att_base_bas_n SET TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_CODE = 'PH' ,last_update_user_id = #{applicationUserId} /* 최종수정사용자아이디 */ ,last_update_date = sysdate /* 최종수정일자 */ ,WORK_HOURS = (CASE WHEN SHIFT_TYPE_CODE like '32%' THEN 9.5 WHEN SHIFT_TYPE_CODE NOT like '32%' AND A_DAY_OF_THE_WEEK_CODE = 'FRI' THEN 8 ELSE 9 END) WHERE time_and_attendance_date = trunc(TO_DATE(#{holidayDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AND SHIFT_TYPE_CODE IN (SELECT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(s.shift_type_codes, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) FROM tb_att_holiday_info_n s WHERE s.holiday_date = trunc(TO_DATE(#{holidayDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(s.shift_type_codes, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL)

mapper.update: UPDATE tb_att_plan_n SET TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_CODE = #{timeAndAttendanceCode}, TIME_ATTEND_DETAIL_CODE = '', LAST_UPDATE_USER_ID = #{applicationUserId}, LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE where TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_CODE NOT IN ('NN', 'US') AND time_and_attendance_date = trunc(TO_DATE(#{holidayDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AND SHIFT_TYPE_CODE IN (SELECT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(s.shift_type_codes, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) FROM tb_att_holiday_info_n s WHERE s.holiday_date = trunc(TO_DATE(#{holidayDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(s.shift_type_codes, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL)

UPDATE tb_att_result_n SET TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_CODE = #{timeAndAttendanceCode}, WORK_HOURS = 0, NORMAL_NIGHT_OVERTIME_HOURS = 0, TIME_ATTEND_DETAIL_CODE = '', LAST_UPDATE_USER_ID = #{applicationUserId}, LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE where TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_CODE NOT IN ('NN', 'US') AND time_and_attendance_date = trunc(TO_DATE(#{holidayDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AND SHIFT_TYPE_CODE IN (SELECT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(s.shift_type_codes, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) FROM tb_att_holiday_info_n s WHERE s.holiday_date = trunc(TO_DATE(#{holidayDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(s.shift_type_codes, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL)
